title: Install the packages
cmd: pip install -q -r requirements.txt && pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '^(anthropic|fastapi|uvicorn) '

title: What a missing key looks like
Stream one answer and time it
Watch the server send events for a live answer
cmd: uvicorn app:app --port 8041 --log-level warning & SERVER=$!; for i in $(seq 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8041/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -sN 'http://127.0.0.1:8041/demo?live=1' > live.sse; kill $SERVER; head -n 12 live.sse; echo '...'; tail -n 5 live.sse; echo; echo "lines in live.sse: $(wc -l < live.sse)"

title: Drop the connection and resume
cmd: uvicorn app:app --port 8041 --log-level warning & SERVER=$!; for i in $(seq 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8041/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; python test_drop.py; STATUS=$?; kill $SERVER; exit $STATUS

title: A reader who leaves mid-answer
cmd: uvicorn app:app --port 8041 --log-level warning > server.log 2>&1 & SERVER=$!; for i in $(seq 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8041/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; python leave_early.py; STATUS=$?; sleep 2; kill $SERVER; echo '--- server terminal ---'; cat server.log; exit $STATUS
